title: The Rune Gates
tagline: Read the draft, the stench and the wings. Loose a crooked arrow.
teaser: Step through glowing rune gates where a cold draft means a pit, a flutter means super-bats and a stench means the wumpus is near. Rise from Lamp-bearer to Master through twelve delves, earn a seal for every quest met, keep a ledger of every delve, fill the lore codex and take the Daily Delve.

manPage.synopsis: wump — walk the halls by draft, stench and wing beat; name up to five chambers and loose a crooked arrow into the wumpus's.
manPage.description: The owner's earlier fancy-web port of wump: rune-lit gates, wind that curls out of the tunnel towards a pit, a drone in the stone, and the original's rules of the hunt. Around it, a delver's career of twelve delves with ranks, a briefing of three quests and a seal for each, a written chronicle of every delve kept in a ledger, a lore codex and a Daily Delve. A second interpretation beside the collection's own wump.

howToPlay: Each chamber has three rune gates; walk through one with 1, 2 or 3, or click it.
A cold draft means a pit next door, a flutter means super-bats, a stench means the wumpus is within two chambers.
Press S, name up to five chambers and loose a crooked arrow: only the chamber it ends in counts.
